name: albiflorin
summary: Monoterpene glycoside from Paeonia lactiflora root associated with neurotransmitter modulation and mild anxiolytic signaling. Traditional use in Chinese medicine; human trial data limited.
description: Albiflorin is a Paeonia glycoside studied for neurotransmitter-related and broader signaling effects; translational claims should reflect evidence strength by indication.
safetyNotes: Mostly preparation-derived. Caution with anticoagulants, pregnancy, and immune-modulating therapies.
dosage: standardized extract or essential-oil-free preparation when oral use is intended
typical_dosage: standardized extract or essential-oil-free preparation when oral use is intended
evidence_grade_explanation: Both evidence signals agree on limited evidence.
evidence_rationale: No study design has been recorded for this profile yet.
